Then nothing is released

  Scenario: AC10 Replay with the same Idempotency-Key
    Given a write with an Idempotency-Key has been recorded
    When the same request is repeated with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the first answer is returned
    Then no second row, no second decision record and no second breach is written

  Scenario: AC11 Activity retry and timeout
    Given an activity of GuaranteeClaimWorkflow times out or fails and is retried
    When the retry runs
    Then the claim row, the decision record and the outbox rows are written once in one transaction
    Then no second breach is raised

  Scenario: AC12 Consumed call fails or does not answer
    Given rwb-case or rwb-source-data does not answer or returns an error to a consumed call
    When the stage reads the call
    Then nothing is written and no breach is raised

  Scenario: AC13 Disallowed status change is refused
    Given a claim in a status the GUARANTEE model does not allow to change to the requested status
    When the caller patches the claim
    Then the change is refused and nothing is written
    Then no decision record is written
